name: Ookami Shirou
source:
"I'm not interested. Please hit on someone else."

A second-year high school student who is the ideal image of a "Japanese wolf." He enjoys shounen manga characters.

He comes from a country that doesn't have a "Henka no Ishi." A land with one resembles peace, while one without one is unsafe and desolate. But since his hometown is an island nation, he maintains public order with his own method of governance.

The feelings that make him turn back into a beast are "sadness" and "anger." However, partly due to his home enviornment, he's more mature than his peers so he rarely transforms.

[Translated from in-game profile]
